The disk filled up and took the api with it: the `report-export` job wrote 40 CSV parts of 512 MB each (about 20 GB) into `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/` between 03:05:00 and 03:12:48, which is the same volume the database lives on.

The deciding line is `2026-03-09T03:14:00 ERROR db: could not extend file "base/16384/2619": No space left on device`. Disk warnings preceded it at 91% (03:09:03) and 99% (03:13:30). Three seconds after the db error the api aborted its transaction and shut down its worker pool, then logged `FATAL api: exiting (status 1)` at 03:14:06.

It never came back. The proxy logged `upstream api refused connection` every two minutes from 03:16:00 through 05:28:00, and the log ends at 05:29:57, so the api was still down at that point.

The `cache: slow command` warnings are unrelated: they run at the same 100–149 ms every ~5 minutes from 02:00, before and after the crash.

To recover, free space in `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/` (the `part-*.csv` files) and then restart the api. Deleting those files is irreversible, so check whether anyone needs the export first. To stop a repeat, the exports need to go to a different volume than the database, or be size-capped. I found no reference to `report-export` in `scripts/`, `app/` or the compose file, so the job is defined somewhere outside this repo.

The log's timestamps are all 2026-03-09, not last night, so confirm this is the right file for the outage you mean.
